cases: 8 one-per-qid clean Progress Views; 6 low and 2 medium ambiguity
frontier_acceptability: Chosen single G# is in the pre-call acceptable_active_gaps set.
premature_downstream: Chosen G# is in unsupported_hypothesis_gaps or generated answer commitment equivalent to it.
source_type_compatibility: Single-reviewer semantic check of model Expected source type against pre-call preferred_source_types for its selected acceptable G#; record reason. A selected unsuitable gap is source-type incompatible for the current frontier.
known_source: Check output D# exists in the view directory and can directly help the selected G#; none is valid if no observed source is suitable.
invalid_policy: Missing/invalid response or unrecognized G# counts against acceptability; retain error, no retry.
gate: Acceptable >=75% of all cases AND closed-gap reselection <=10% AND premature downstream <=15%; report low-ambiguity subset separately.
